text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye, it was already the 
final day of summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *whew*... Trainer, thank you 
very much for your hard work...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It is so I can take on a bear in single 
combat!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The final day is meant for checking our 
progress, isn't it? So I shall demonstrate 
just how much stronger my power has grown!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Though unfortunately, we didn't get to 
meet them.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I called out so many times, you know? 
Parting the grass, digging through tree 
roots. Yet, nowhere to be found...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Trainer? You suddenly crouched 
down... And your face is completely 
pale......?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
!? A-An ambulance, call an ambulance!! 
Trainer, don't die on meeeeee!!

That won't kill me. However, trying to 
fight a bear is far too dangerous. I gave 
her strict instructions never to do it 
again.
